_comment: APPROVED reviews only. Nothing here publishes automatically — an item renders on the site ONLY when status='published' AND approved=true, which is a deliberate human edit + commit + build. Never add fabricated, incentivized, or unverified reviews. Workflow: draft -> internal_review -> legal_review -> approved -> published -> archived.

_schema.author: string (client first name or initials, with consent)
_schema.text: string (the client's own words, verbatim, with consent)
_schema.status: draft | internal_review | legal_review | approved | published | archived
_schema.approved: boolean — must be true AND status='published' to render
